Container.Name: PoopiePay
Container.Overview: PoopiePay is a fast, ultra-minimalist, Bauhaus-styled UPI QR Code Generator with a persistent file data saver. Designed to run as a single static binary (~12MB Docker image) with zero heavy dependencies. Easily generate real-time UPI QR codes for GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Cred, and Navi payments. Automatically pre-populates payee UPI ID and transaction notes from persistent disk storage.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: poopiepay upi qr code generator payment gpay phonepe paytm bhim minimalist bauhaus
Container.Changes: [Initial Release] - Official Unraid template for PoopiePay.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port used by the PoopiePay web interface.

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Persistent directory for storing PoopiePay data.json (saved UPI ID, remarks, and recent transactions).
